workbench.replay.fields: Facts preserve recording order; events preserve rule confirmation order. fact_index and input_fact_index reference facts; event_index numbers events and is not a triggering fact index. All *_frames fields use exact integers in 48 kHz frame units; negative and post-EOF watermarks remain unchanged. null means unavailable. Replay v1 records no device timestamps; physical input latency is unavailable.

Beat, section and energy context are original analysis facts
